your_book:
Tuesday was a broadly constructive day for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio sitting at $24,036 and an unrealized gain of +5.07% (+$1,160). The headline movers were AVGO (+6.62%) and RKLB (+5.75%), followed by a software sweep — NOW (+3.45%), GILD (+3.19%), SAP (+3.12%), and ADBE (+2.43%) — all lifted by a sector rotation trade as investors pivoted away from AI hardware into enterprise software ahead of Microsoft's post-close earnings. NVDA also added 2.56% on the day despite lingering export-control headwinds. The drag came from the healthcare side: ABT slipped 1.52%, ZTS fell 1.43%, and DHR gave back 1.37%, each in modest pullbacks with no fresh catalysts flagged.

The drift worth watching is RKLB. At 15.5% of the book — the single largest position — it's up 5.75% today yet still sits at a –5.0% position gain and carries an AVOID verdict with a QARP of just 41.6. Today's pop looks tied to competitive noise (SpaceX crowding out rival payloads) rather than any positive catalyst for Rocket Lab itself. Price and thesis are moving in opposite directions: a strong day in a deteriorating competitive narrative. ZTS is a quieter version of the same problem — STRONG BUY rated, QARP 84.6, but down 3.5% since entry and slipping again today. The quality case is intact, but price hasn't agreed for a while.

Keep an eye on the pharma cluster heading into the close of today's policy window: the GILD·NVS·NBIX·VRTX drug-pricing risk flag has a next-date of August 4 — that's today — meaning any MFN pricing announcements or tariff developments are live right now. GILD gained 3.19% on the session, which is encouraging, but the policy overhang doesn't lift on a good tape day. BSX's guidance cut (FY26 growth slashed to 7–8.5%) also deserves a reassessment given it's still rated STRONG BUY — next earnings aren't until October 20, so there's time, but the thesis needs to hold at the reduced growth rate.

attention.headline: Largest position, AVOID-rated, still underwater — today's pop doesn't fix the thesis
attention.note: At 15.5% of the book, RKLB is the single biggest weight yet carries an AVOID verdict, a QARP of 41.6, and a –5.0% position loss; the SpaceX payload-crowding headline is a competitive negative, not a catalyst, making today's +5.75% a potential trim opportunity rather than a reason to hold.

attention.headline: Drug-pricing policy risk flag matures today — monitor for MFN or tariff announcements
attention.note: The risk flag's next-review date is August 4 (today), meaning any Trump MFN pricing deal updates or import-tariff actions are live in this session and could reprice the entire pharma cluster simultaneously.

attention.headline: STRONG BUY rating vs. slashed guidance needs reconciliation
attention.note: FY26 growth was cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5% with management guiding flat through Q3, yet BSX still carries a STRONG BUY verdict — the quality score and thesis should be stress-tested against the lower growth trajectory before the next print on October 20.

attention.headline: Highest QARP in the book (84.6), STRONG BUY — but price keeps disagreeing
attention.note: Zoetis is down 3.5% since entry and slipped another 1.43% today with no fresh catalyst, meaning the gap between the quality thesis and actual price action is widening and warrants a check on whether the underlying business drivers are still on track.
